candidate.title: PARS / dsRNA-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned middle row of the Illumina poster, labeled PARS and dsRNA-Seq. Its inventory is a structural RNA icon, PolyA RNA, two separate RNase digestion lanes (upper RNase S1 at an unpaired loop/flanks; lower RNase V1 at a paired stem), RNA fragments labeled 5′ P and 3′ OH, separate Random fragmentation panels containing both 5′ P and 5′ OH ends, and separate Reverse transcription panels passing through purple/blue duplexes to blue cDNA endpoints. The structural icon does not establish an additional extraction, folding or poly(A)-selection operation. Neighboring SPARE and PARTE rows, including the latter’s temperature alternatives, are outside the assigned card. The matching catalogue heading PARS-Seq: Parallel Analysis of RNA Structure supports treating PARS-Seq as catalogue nomenclature for this PARS depiction, rather than another target. PARS and dsRNA-Seq remain distinct methods: the complete drawn preparation history is assigned to PARS at schematic scope; the cited Zheng dsRNA-Seq implementation is represented by a separate, explicitly paper-supported local interface to resolve the grouped caption. This interface preserves its rRNA-depleted total-RNA input and RNase One survival readout, without importing the drawn PARS end chemistry. Downstream sequencing and structural interpretation are described as readout effects rather than added as unshown diagram operations.
